subject.title: fix(image): mixed-source image input for vision-capable models

question: Should OpenClaw natively preload prompt-written remote image URLs for vision turns, and what URL scope is acceptable for that prompt-controlled network fetch path?
rationale: The central bug fix needs remote image URLs to reach the first vision request, but the submitted implementation makes user prompt text initiate network fetches, so maintainers should choose the supported safety boundary before merge.

options.title: Narrow native preload to explicit image URLs
options.body: Preload only image-shaped remote URLs, forward configured SSRF policy, and leave ambiguous or extensionless links on the existing fallback/tool path unless separately approved.

options.title: Keep remote URLs on the fallback path
options.body: Reject native remote URL preloading for now and solve the linked issue by improving image-tool exposure or user-visible fallback behavior instead.

options.title: Allow broad remote URL sniffing
options.body: Accept content-type sniffing for arbitrary prompt URLs only with explicit maintainer ownership of the latency, privacy, and SSRF-policy surface.

recommendation.title: Narrow native preload to explicit image URLs
recommendation.body: Preload only image-shaped remote URLs, forward configured SSRF policy, and leave ambiguous or extensionless links on the existing fallback/tool path unless separately approved.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent native-image and sanitization commits make this the best available routing candidate for the media-safety boundary decision.
